translations.en: We'll use this to undo the seal, then use what @7rBeatrix@0r brought back
to seal it once more.
Afterward, we'll add every seal we can,
so it can never be opened again.
In that case, I'll help too.
I'm getting tired of waiting around.
But we haven't finished deciphering that statue we found.
Without more time to study it, we don't know what might happen...
No, we don't have the luxury of waiting anymore.
Let's seal it quickly, before a new threat appears.
@7rBeatrix@0r looks uneasy,
but @7rAnselm@0r has a point. Before another threat like @7rGate Keeper@0r
appears, it makes sense to seal it again.
I want you to serve as our bodyguards.
Our destination is the gate on the lowest level of @6rGraham@0r.
I'll be brief. We must return to the lowest level of @6rGraham@0r
and defeat @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r.
This is something only we can do now.
We must see it through.
I've learned the truth about the seal.
The truth is... it requires sacrifices.
At the word "sacrifices,"
everyone present falls silent, unable to hide their shock.
I-I'll pass on being a sacrifice, thanks.
Don't decide the thief should be sacrificed because thieves are useless
in situations like this. That's class discrimination!
Heeheehee...
If it needed a human sacrifice, I'd gladly offer myself.
But it doesn't. The sacrifices must be the guardian of the gate and the master of the key.
Do you understand? In other words, @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r.
Wha...
So @7rAnselm@0r bringing them back
turned out to help us, by sheer chance...?
Yes. If @7rAnselm@0r hadn't summoned @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r,
we wouldn't have been able to do anything...
For better or worse.
So I have two things to ask of you.
First, protect me and @7rCarmine@0r while we perform the ritual
in front of the otherworldly gate.
Second, defeat @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r
in front of the otherworldly gate.
If you defeat @7rGate Keeper@0r and @7rKey Master@0r before the gate,
the seal will be complete.
Then we can truly free the city trapped by the gate's curse.
Please do your best!
It's almost absurd that the fate of the world should rest
on young women like us, with no one the wiser.
If we fail, people will meet their end
without even knowing why.
The bards may never sing of this battle,
but let's fight to see tomorrow's sunrise.
You nod. With the lowest level of @6rGraham Labyrinth@0r as your destination,
you decide to set out.
You received a @3rParagraph Weapon@0r.
Good work!
I'll count up the treasure now,
so please wait a moment.
Back at the tavern, @7rTanya@0r
carefully counts the money from the box
and hands half of it to you.
Here's your share!
From @7rTanya@0r, you received @3r9,800 G@0r as your share.
And this item is too good for @7rTanya@0r,
so I want you to have it.
From @7rTanya@0r, you received a @3rParagraph Weapon@0r.
That was fun!
If I find another treasure map,
I want you to come and play with me again!
See you later!
What's the matter? Let's go!
Oh? Have you decided to come with me?
I'm so touched!
You will, won't you?
I'll tell you where the treasure is right away.
On the second floor of @6rStrage@0r,
four paces from the left and five paces from the bottom,
translations.note: Coordinate clue is four paces from the left and five from the bottom, not cardinal directions or zero-based indices.

translations.en: there's a hidden treasure chest.
My dad is often ill, so @7rTanya@0r wants to strike it rich
and make life easier for him.
Now, let's go treasure hunting!

context: The party learns Gate Keeper and Key Master are ritual sacrifices; Tanya proposes treasure hunting and searches for the missing stuffed bunny.
decisions: Control tokens remain on their source rows and in their original sequence. Genuine sentence continuations retain row boundaries; other omitted subjects are restored from scene context. Unknown historical warrior gender stays neutral. Item names follow the shared glossary; established imported prose and provenance remain intact.
